conventions: Run all project Python through ./env.sh (./env.sh python …, ./env.sh pytest …): ROS Humble leaks py3.10 paths into conda envs and env.sh scrubs them (docs/adr/007).
ROS 2 work: rclpy nodes use /usr/bin/python3; `set +u` before sourcing /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash; keep ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 and the ROS_DOMAIN_ID already set in your environment.
Never modify ~/rebot_ws, ~/rebot_lerobot or other projects: consume ~/rebot_ws/install as a read-only underlay; new ROS packages live in this repo under ros2_ws/src/.
Never commit data/, models/, logs/, build outputs or large binaries (git-lfs is not installed).

docs/INTERFACES.md contracts are normative, especially §0.5 frame invariant: mask, skeleton and aligned depth share (row, col) in the original colour frame. New contracts are APPENDED as new numbered sections.
Every CLI follows docs/INTERFACES.md §0: exit codes 0/1/2/3 and the common flags.
No robot motion from code paths reachable without the commissioning gate: default to mock/dry-run.
The GPU is shared: never kill GPU processes; degrade per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §9.
